observations: Photo shows a stack of marketing/sales books with visible titles/spines: “RICH DAD POOR DAD” (top), “THIS IS MARKETING” (Seth Godin), “SELL LIKE CRAZY” (Sabr Suby), “CRUSHING IT!” (Gary Vaynerchuk), “GUERRILLA MARKETING” (text visible), “SELL OR BE SOLD” (Grant Cardone), and “HOW TO GET CUSTOMERS…” (partially visible).
No photo shows the full set count, condition (cover wear/pages), edition/year, or whether any books are missing/damaged.

claims.claim: Sellected collection of books on marketing and sales
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows multiple marketing/sales book spines (e.g., Seth Godin, Grant Cardone, Gary Vaynerchuk, Guerrilla Marketing).

risks.risk: Missing books or fewer/more titles than expected (bundle size not shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing all books laid out flat with a count (or a list of titles) and close-ups of each spine.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used mixed bundle with unknown completeness.

risks.risk: Condition issues (torn covers, missing pages, heavy highlighting/notes, water damage).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of: front cover, back cover, spine, and 2–3 random open pages showing page condition/notes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed—assume average wear.

risks.risk: Edition/printing differences (some titles vary by edition; value can change).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the copyright/edition page inside each book (or at least for the most valuable titles).

risks.risk: Authenticity/bootleg risk (hard to confirm from one spine photo).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the ISBN/copyright page for 1–2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as genuine only if proven; otherwise treat as standard used without premium.

proof_requests: How many books are included in the bundle? (photo with all books laid out + count)
Close-ups: front cover, back cover, spine, and 2–3 random open pages per book (showing highlighting/notes and page condition)
Photos of the copyright/ISBN page for the top 2–3 titles (to confirm edition/authenticity)
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a marketing/sales book bundle, but the bundle size and condition/edition are not verifiable remotely, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the missing shots.
